mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ragnarok</titleLeft><mainText>Olaf is immune to disables and has increased Attack Damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yasuo creates a drifting wall of wind that knocks away and blocks enemy units and projectiles for @WallLife@ seconds.

Yasuo gains @TotalShieldValue@ shield and dashes in a direction, dealing @DashThruDamage@ damage to enemies he passes through.

Can hold up to 3 charges.

Yasuo gains @CritChanceAmount*100@% Critical Strike Chance.

Crits grant @WindGain@ Flow.
